## File: src/labs/hypatho.ts

```ts
/**
 * Hy Patho Lab (lab.hypatholab.in) reports.
 *
 * Page: "PROCESSED AT: HY PATHO LAB / RAIPUR" top right; a three-column header (x≈20 / 240 / 426);
 * a centred test title; a table "TEST DESCRIPTION | RESULT | UNITS | BIO. REF. RANGES [| METHOD]";
 * "Method: X" under each row; narrative notes; "~~End of report~~"; the signature image bottom right on
 * the page where a test ends. A test continues on the next page when no title is printed there.
 * The signer's name is only inside the signature image, so naming needs a KnownSignature registry.
 */
import type { Line, PdfDoc } from "../pdf";
import { cells, headerColumns, makeParameter, METHOD_LINE, type Columns } from "../table";
import { isSquare } from "../registry";
import { emptyReport, field, headerFields, isoDate, parseAge, parseSex, splitTitle, uniq } from "../text";
import type { Parameter, TestSection } from "../types";
import { FOOTER_PAGE, joinWrapped, type LabParse } from "./common";

export const isHypatho = (doc: PdfDoc) =>
  doc.pages.slice(0, 2).some((p) => p.lines.some((l) => /HY\s*PATHO\s*LAB|hypatholab/i.test(l.text)));

const LABELS = [
  /^PT\.?\s*Name\b\s*:?/i,
  /^Patient\s*Name\b\s*:?/i,
  /^Age\b\s*:?/i,
  /^Ref(?:\.|erred)?\s*By(?:\s*Dr\.?)?\s*:?/i,
  /^Registered\s*on\s*:?/i,
  /^Booking\s*Id\s*:?/i,
  /^Received\s*on\s*:?/i,
  /^Barcode\s*Id\s*:?/i,
  /^Reported\s*on\s*:?/i,
  /^SAMPLE\s*COLLECTED\s*AT\s*:?/i,
  /^SAMPLE(?:\s*TYPE)?\s*:?/i,
  /^INV\b\s*:?/i,
];

const END = /~~\s*End\s*of\s*report\s*~~/i;
const NAME_TOL = 3;

export function parseHypatho(doc: PdfDoc): LabParse {
  const out: LabParse = { lab: "hypatho", labName: "Hy Patho Lab", ...emptyReport(), signatures: [] };
  const regs: string[] = [], recs: string[] = [], reps: string[] = [];
  let cur: TestSection | null = null;
  let cols: Columns | null = null;
  let mode: "table" | "notes" = "table";
  let last: (Parameter & { group?: string }) | null = null;
  let group: string | undefined;

  const note = (s: string) => {
    if (cur) cur.notes = cur.notes ? `${cur.notes}\n${s}` : s;
  };

  for (const page of doc.pages) {
    const lines = page.lines.filter((l) => l.y < page.height - 30 && !FOOTER_PAGE.test(l.text));
    const thIdx = lines.findIndex((l) => headerColumns(l));
    const titleIdx = thIdx > 0 && lines[thIdx - 1]!.items[0]!.x > 120 && lines[thIdx - 1]!.y > 195 ? thIdx - 1 : -1;
    const headEnd = titleIdx >= 0 ? titleIdx : thIdx >= 0 ? thIdx : lines.findIndex((l) => l.y > 200);
    const head = lines.slice(0, headEnd < 0 ? lines.length : headEnd);

    // processed-at block, top right
    const pa = head.findIndex((l) => /PROCESSED\s*AT/i.test(l.text));
    if (pa >= 0 && !out.processedAt && lines[pa]!.y < 100) {
      const rest = [lines[pa]!.text.replace(/.*PROCESSED\s*AT\s*:?/i, ""), lines[pa + 1]?.text, lines[pa + 2]?.text];
      out.processedAt = rest.filter((s) => s?.trim() && lines[pa]!.y < 100).map((s) => s!.trim()).filter((s) => !/:\s*$/.test(s)).slice(0, 2).join(", ") || undefined;
    }

    const f = headerFields(head.filter((l) => l.y > 100), [230, 420], LABELS);
    if (!out.patient.name) {
      const { title, name } = splitTitle(field(f, /name/i));
      const ageRaw = field(f, /^age/i);
      const [ageText, sex] = (ageRaw ?? "").split(/\|?\s*Gender\s*:?\s*/i);
      Object.assign(out.patient, { name, title, ...parseAge(ageText), sex: parseSex(sex) });
      out.sample.referredBy = field(f, /^ref/i);
      out.sample.bookingId = field(f, /booking/i);
      out.sample.collectedAt = field(f, /collected/i);
    }
    out.sample.barcodes.push(...(field(f, /barcode/i)?.split(/[,\s]+/) ?? []));
    out.sample.ordered.push(field(f, /^inv/i) ?? "");
    regs.push(isoDate(field(f, /registered/i)) ?? "");
    recs.push(isoDate(field(f, /received/i)) ?? "");
    reps.push(isoDate(field(f, /reported/i)) ?? "");
    const sampleType = f.find((x) => /^sample(\s*type)?$/i.test(x.label))?.value || undefined;

    if (titleIdx >= 0) {
      const raw = lines[titleIdx]!.text;
      const mark = raw.match(/^([*#†]+)\s*/);
      cur = { name: raw.slice(mark?.[0].length ?? 0).trim(), sampleType, parameters: [], pages: [], signedBy: [], ...(mark ? { mark: mark[1] } : {}) };
      out.tests.push(cur);
      mode = "table";
      last = null;
      group = undefined;
    }
    if (thIdx >= 0) cols = headerColumns(lines[thIdx]!);
    const body = thIdx >= 0 ? lines.slice(thIdx + 1) : lines.slice(head.length);
    if (cur && body.length && !cur.pages.includes(page.number)) cur.pages.push(page.number);

    for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
      const line = body[i]!;
      if (END.test(line.text)) {
        cur = null;
        continue;
      }
      if (!cur) continue;
      if (mode === "notes" || !cols) {
        note(line.text);
        continue;
      }
      const c = cells(line, cols);
      const atName = Math.abs(line.items[0]!.x - cols.name) <= NAME_TOL;
      const onlyName = !c.result && !c.unit && !c.range && !c.method;
      const isRow = (l: Line | undefined) => !!l && Math.abs(l.items[0]!.x - cols!.name) <= NAME_TOL && !!cells(l, cols!).result && !METHOD_LINE.test(cells(l, cols!).name);
      const method = c.name.match(METHOD_LINE);

      if (atName && method) {
        // a method line; may also carry a range continuation in the range column
        if (last) last.method ??= method[1]!.trim();
        if (last && c.range) last.range = last.range ? `${last.range}\n${c.range}` : c.range;
      } else if (atName && c.result) {
        last = { ...makeParameter(c.name, c), ...(group ? { group } : {}) };
        cur.parameters.push(last);
      } else if (!c.name && c.result && !c.unit && !c.range && last && body[i - 1] && line.y - body[i - 1]!.y < 14) {
        last.value = joinWrapped(last.value, c.result); // long text result wrapped onto the next line
      } else if (!c.name && !c.result && (c.range || c.method) && last) {
        if (c.range) last.range = last.range ? `${last.range}\n${c.range}` : c.range;
        if (c.method) last.method = last.method ? `${last.method} ${c.method}` : c.method;
      } else if (atName && onlyName && last && body[i - 1] && line.y - body[i - 1]!.y < 14 && isRow(body[i - 1])) {
        last.name = `${last.name} ${c.name}`; // wrapped name, e.g. "(MCHC)"
      } else if (atName && onlyName && isRow(body.slice(i + 1).find((l) => !METHOD_LINE.test(l.text)))) {
        group = c.name; // sub-heading inside the table
      } else {
        mode = "notes";
        note(line.text);
      }
    }
    for (const img of page.images) {
      const { x, y, w, h } = img.box;
      if (y > page.height * 0.75 && x > page.width * 0.6 && w <= 220 && w / Math.max(h, 1) >= 1.3 && !isSquare(img))
        out.signatures.push({ page: page.number, image: img });
    }
  }

  for (const t of out.tests) if (!t.notes) delete t.notes;
  out.sample.barcodes = uniq(out.sample.barcodes);
  out.sample.ordered = uniq(out.sample.ordered);
  out.sample.sampleIds = [];
  const first = (xs: string[]) => xs.find(Boolean);
  const latest = (xs: string[]) => xs.filter(Boolean).sort().pop();
  out.dates = { registered: first(regs), received: first(recs), reported: latest(reps) };
  return out;
}
```

## File: src/pdf.ts

```ts
/**
 * PDF layer: text lines with coordinates, and embedded images with placement, pixels and fingerprints.
 * Uses the PDF's own text layer (exact) — lab reports from LIS software are digital, not scans.
 */
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { deflateSync } from "node:zlib";
import type { Box } from "./types";

// pdfjs-dist is ESM; the legacy build runs in Node without a canvas.
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type Pdfjs = any;
let pdfjsP: Promise<Pdfjs> | undefined;
const loadPdfjs = () => (pdfjsP ??= import("pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs" as string));

export interface TextItem {
  x: number;
  /** distance from the top of the page (baseline) */
  y: number;
  w: number;
  s: string;
}

export interface Line {
  y: number;
  items: TextItem[];
  /** items joined with single spaces */
  text: string;
}

export interface PdfImage {
  page: number;
  box: Box;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  rgba: Uint8ClampedArray;
  /** sha256 of the decoded pixels (first 16 hex chars): identical image → identical id */
  sha: string;
  /** 64-bit difference hash: near-identical images differ by a few bits */
  dhash: string;
}

export interface PdfPage {
  number: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  lines: Line[];
  images: PdfImage[];
}

export interface PdfDoc {
  pages: PdfPage[];
  sha256: string;
}

const mul = (m: number[], n: number[]) => [
  m[0]! * n[0]! + m[2]! * n[1]!, m[1]! * n[0]! + m[3]! * n[1]!, m[0]! * n[2]! + m[2]! * n[3]!,
  m[1]! * n[2]! + m[3]! * n[3]!, m[0]! * n[4]! + m[2]! * n[5]! + m[4]!, m[1]! * n[4]! + m[3]! * n[5]! + m[5]!,
];

function toRGBA(img: { width: number; height: number; kind: number; data: Uint8ClampedArray }): Uint8ClampedArray {
  const { width: w, height: h, kind, data } = img;
  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h * 4);
  if (kind === 3) out.set(data.subarray(0, w * h * 4));
  else if (kind === 2) for (let i = 0, j = 0; i < w * h; i++) { out[j++] = data[i * 3]!; out[j++] = data[i * 3 + 1]!; out[j++] = data[i * 3 + 2]!; out[j++] = 255; }
  else {
    const rb = (w + 7) >> 3;
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      const v = (data[y * rb + (x >> 3)]! >> (7 - (x & 7))) & 1 ? 255 : 0;
      const j = (y * w + x) * 4; out[j] = out[j + 1] = out[j + 2] = v; out[j + 3] = 255;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** 9×8 grey thumbnail → 64 bits (is each pixel brighter than its right neighbour). */
export function dhash(rgba: Uint8ClampedArray, w: number, h: number): string {
  const grey = (x: number, y: number) => {
    // average a block, compositing transparent pixels onto white
    const x0 = Math.floor((x * w) / 9), x1 = Math.max(x0 + 1, Math.floor(((x + 1) * w) / 9));
    const y0 = Math.floor((y * h) / 8), y1 = Math.max(y0 + 1, Math.floor(((y + 1) * h) / 8));
    let s = 0, n = 0;
    for (let yy = y0; yy < y1; yy++) for (let xx = x0; xx < x1; xx++) {
      const j = (yy * w + xx) * 4; const a = rgba[j + 3]! / 255;
      s += (0.299 * rgba[j]! + 0.587 * rgba[j + 1]! + 0.114 * rgba[j + 2]!) * a + 255 * (1 - a); n++;
    }
    return s / n;
  };
  let bits = 0n;
  for (let y = 0; y < 8; y++) for (let x = 0; x < 8; x++) bits = (bits << 1n) | (grey(x, y) > grey(x + 1, y) ? 1n : 0n);
  return bits.toString(16).padStart(16, "0");
}

export const hamming = (a: string, b: string) => {
  let x = BigInt("0x" + a) ^ BigInt("0x" + b), n = 0;
  while (x) { n += Number(x & 1n); x >>= 1n; }
  return n;
};

const crcTable = Array.from({ length: 256 }, (_, n) => { let c = n; for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = c & 1 ? 0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1) : c >>> 1; return c >>> 0; });
const crc32 = (b: Buffer) => { let c = 0xffffffff; for (const x of b) c = crcTable[(c ^ x) & 0xff]! ^ (c >>> 8); return (c ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0; };

/** RGBA → PNG bytes (no dependencies). */
export function toPng(img: Pick<PdfImage, "width" | "height" | "rgba">): Buffer {
  const { width: w, height: h, rgba } = img;
  const raw = Buffer.alloc((w * 4 + 1) * h);
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) Buffer.from(rgba.buffer, rgba.byteOffset + y * w * 4, w * 4).copy(raw, y * (w * 4 + 1) + 1);
  const chunk = (t: string, d: Buffer) => {
    const len = Buffer.alloc(4); len.writeUInt32BE(d.length);
    const td = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(t), d]); const c = Buffer.alloc(4); c.writeUInt32BE(crc32(td));
    return Buffer.concat([len, td, c]);
  };
  const ihdr = Buffer.alloc(13); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(w, 0); ihdr.writeUInt32BE(h, 4); ihdr[8] = 8; ihdr[9] = 6;
  return Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]), chunk("IHDR", ihdr), chunk("IDAT", deflateSync(raw)), chunk("IEND", Buffer.alloc(0))]);
}

/** Group text items into lines (same baseline ± tolerance), left to right. */
function toLines(items: TextItem[], tol = 2.5): Line[] {
  const sorted = items.slice().sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y || a.x - b.x);
  const lines: Line[] = [];
  for (const it of sorted) {
    const last = lines[lines.length - 1];
    if (last && Math.abs(last.y - it.y) <= tol) last.items.push(it);
    else lines.push({ y: it.y, items: [it], text: "" });
  }
  for (const l of lines) {
    l.items.sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
    l.text = l.items.map((i) => i.s).join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  }
  return lines;
}

export async function readPdf(data: Uint8Array, opts: { images?: boolean } = {}): Promise<PdfDoc> {
  const pdfjs = await loadPdfjs();
  const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");
  const task = pdfjs.getDocument({ data: new Uint8Array(data), verbosity: 0, isOffscreenCanvasSupported: false });
  const doc = await task.promise;
  const pages: PdfPage[] = [];
  try {
    for (let p = 1; p <= doc.numPages; p++) {
      const page = await doc.getPage(p);
      const vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
      const tc = await page.getTextContent();
      const items: TextItem[] = [];
      for (const it of tc.items as { str: string; transform: number[]; width: number }[]) {
        const s = it.str.replace(/ /g, " ").trim();
        if (!s || /^[█▌▐ ]+$/.test(s)) continue; // barcodes drawn as block glyphs
        items.push({ x: it.transform[4]!, y: vp.height - it.transform[5]!, w: it.width, s });
      }
      const images: PdfImage[] = [];
      if (opts.images !== false) {
        const ops = await page.getOperatorList();
        const O = pdfjs.OPS;
        let ctm = [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
        const stack: number[][] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < ops.fnArray.length; i++) {
          const fn = ops.fnArray[i], a = ops.argsArray[i];
          if (fn === O.save) stack.push(ctm);
          else if (fn === O.restore) ctm = stack.pop() ?? ctm;
          else if (fn === O.transform) ctm = mul(ctm, a);
          else if (fn === O.paintImageXObject) {
            const img = await new Promise<any>((res) => (String(a[0]).startsWith("g_") ? page.commonObjs : page.objs).get(a[0], res));
            if (!img?.data) continue;
            const rgba = toRGBA(img);
            images.push({
              page: p,
              box: { x: ctm[4]!, y: vp.height - (ctm[5]! + ctm[3]!), w: ctm[0]!, h: ctm[3]! },
              width: img.width, height: img.height, rgba,
              sha: createHash("sha256").update(rgba).digest("hex").slice(0, 16),
              dhash: dhash(rgba, img.width, img.height),
            });
          }
        }
      }
      pages.push({ number: p, width: vp.width, height: vp.height, lines: toLines(items), images });
      page.cleanup();
    }
  } finally {
    await task.destroy();
  }
  return { pages, sha256 };
}
```

## File: src/registry.ts

```ts
/**
 * Image registry: accreditation marks we recognise, and lookup of caller-supplied signatures.
 * Signatures of real people are NOT shipped in this package; pass them in (ExtractOptions.signatures).
 */
import { hamming, type PdfImage } from "./pdf";
import type { KnownSignature } from "./types";

/** dHash distance that still counts as the same picture (re-encoded / rescaled copies). */
export const NEAR = 6;

interface Mark {
  sha: string[];
  dhash: string[];
  body: "NABL";
  /** certificate printed inside the mark, when it is part of the artwork */
  certificate?: string;
}

/** NABL + ilac-MRA marks as printed by partner labs (logo artwork, not personal data). */
export const ACCREDITATION_MARKS: Mark[] = [
  // Clinova Pathlabs: ilac-MRA + NABL "MC-3860", printed at the top of accredited pages and in the footer
  { body: "NABL", certificate: "MC-3860", sha: ["8b61adacec186d92", "fc45707177fc87ef"], dhash: ["cece4ea48ec6acce"] },
];

const near = (d: string, list: string[] | undefined) => !!list?.some((x) => hamming(x, d) <= NEAR);

export function accreditationMark(img: PdfImage): Mark | undefined {
  return ACCREDITATION_MARKS.find((m) => m.sha.includes(img.sha) || near(img.dhash, m.dhash));
}

/** The registered signature this image is, if any (exact pixels first, then perceptual match). */
export function knownSignature(img: Pick<PdfImage, "sha" | "dhash">, registry: KnownSignature[] = []): KnownSignature | undefined {
  return registry.find((k) => k.sha?.includes(img.sha)) ?? registry.find((k) => near(img.dhash, k.dhash));
}

/** Square, QR-like images (one per report, never a signature). */
export const isSquare = (img: PdfImage) => Math.abs(img.width - img.height) <= Math.max(img.width, img.height) * 0.08;
```

## File: src/table.ts

```ts
/**
 * Result tables, shared by every lab: a header row ("Test Description | Result | Units | Ranges | Method")
 * fixes the column x positions; each later line is a parameter row, a continuation, a method line, a
 * sub-heading, or narrative.
 */
import type { Line } from "./pdf";
import type { Flag, Parameter } from "./types";

export interface Columns {
  name: number;
  result: number;
  unit?: number;
  range?: number;
  method?: number;
}

const SLOP = 7;

/** Column positions from a header line, or null when the line is not a table header. */
export function headerColumns(line: Line): Columns | null {
  const t = line.text.toUpperCase();
  if (!/TEST\s*DESCRIPTION|INVESTIGATION|PARAMETER/.test(t) || !/RESULT/.test(t)) return null;
  const at = (re: RegExp) => line.items.find((i) => re.test(i.s.toUpperCase()))?.x;
  const name = at(/TEST|INVESTIGATION|PARAMETER/) ?? line.items[0]!.x;
  const result = at(/^RESULTS?$|RESULT/);
  if (result === undefined) return null;
  return { name, result, unit: at(/^UNITS?$|UNIT/), range: at(/RANGE|REFERENCE|INTERVAL/), method: at(/^METHOD/) };
}

/** Split a line's items into the table's cells. */
export function cells(line: Line, c: Columns) {
  const bounds = [
    ["name", -Infinity, c.result - SLOP],
    ["result", c.result - SLOP, (c.unit ?? c.range ?? c.method ?? Infinity) - SLOP],
    ["unit", (c.unit ?? Infinity) - SLOP, (c.range ?? c.method ?? Infinity) - SLOP],
    ["range", (c.range ?? Infinity) - SLOP, (c.method ?? Infinity) - SLOP],
    ["method", (c.method ?? Infinity) - SLOP, Infinity],
  ] as const;
  const out: Record<"name" | "result" | "unit" | "range" | "method", string> = { name: "", result: "", unit: "", range: "", method: "" };
  for (const it of line.items) {
    const b = bounds.find(([, lo, hi]) => it.x >= lo && it.x < hi);
    if (b) out[b[0]] = (out[b[0]] ? out[b[0]] + " " : "") + it.s;
  }
  for (const k of Object.keys(out) as (keyof typeof out)[]) out[k] = out[k].replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  return out;
}

const num = (s: string) => {
  const m = s.replace(/,/g, "").match(/^[<>]?\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);
  return m ? Number(m[1]) : NaN;
};

/** H / L from a numeric value and a simple range: "a - b", "a–b", "< x", "> x", "Up to x". */
export function computeFlag(value: string, range?: string): Flag {
  if (!range) return "";
  const v = num(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(v) || /[a-z]{3,}/i.test(value.replace(/^[<>]/, ""))) return "";
  const r = range.split("\n")[0]!.replace(/,/g, "").trim();
  let m = r.match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*[-–—]\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/);
  if (m) return v < Number(m[1]) ? "L" : v > Number(m[2]) ? "H" : "";
  if ((m = r.match(/^(?:<|<=|≤|up\s*to|upto)\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/i))) return v > Number(m[1]) ? "H" : "";
  if ((m = r.match(/^(?:>|>=|≥)\s*(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)$/i))) return v < Number(m[1]) ? "L" : "";
  return "";
}

/** "11.2 L" / "H 15" / "15 *" → value + printed flag. */
export function splitFlag(raw: string): { value: string; flag: Flag | null } {
  let m = raw.match(/^(.*\S)\s+([HL])$/);
  if (m) return { value: m[1]!, flag: m[2] as Flag };
  m = raw.match(/^([HL])\s+(\S.*)$/);
  if (m) return { value: m[2]!, flag: m[1] as Flag };
  return { value: raw, flag: null };
}

export const METHOD_LINE = /^\(?\s*method\s*[:\-]\s*(.*?[^\s\-–—].*?)\)?$/i;

export function makeParameter(name: string, cell: ReturnType<typeof cells>): Parameter {
  const { value, flag } = splitFlag(cell.result);
  const range = cell.range || undefined;
  return {
    name,
    value,
    unit: /^[.\-–—]?$/.test(cell.unit) ? undefined : cell.unit, // "." / "-" placeholders mean no unit
    range,
    method: cell.method || undefined,
    flag: flag ?? computeFlag(value, range),
  };
}
```

## File: src/text.ts

```ts
/** Small text helpers shared by the lab parsers: dates, ages, names, signatory lines, header key/values. */
import type { Line } from "./pdf";
import type { ExtractedReport, SignatoryRole } from "./types";

const pad = (n: number | string) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");

/**
 * Printed date-time → ISO local time "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" (reports print Indian time without a zone).
 * Accepts "16-06-2026 06:25 PM", "16/06/2026 18:25", "2026-03-10 18:46". Unparseable → trimmed input.
 */
export function isoDate(raw: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  const s = raw?.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!s) return undefined;
  let d: string, mo: string, y: string;
  let m = s.match(/^(\d{4})[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})(.*)$/);
  if (m) [, y, mo, d] = m as unknown as [string, string, string, string];
  else if ((m = s.match(/^(\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{1,2})[-/.](\d{4})(.*)$/))) [, d, mo, y] = m as unknown as [string, string, string, string];
  else return s;
  const rest = m[4]!.trim();
  const date = `${y}-${pad(mo)}-${pad(d)}`;
  const t = rest.match(/^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})(?::\d{2})?\s*(AM|PM)?$/i);
  if (!t) return rest ? s : date;
  let h = Number(t[1]);
  if (t[3]) h = (h % 12) + (/pm/i.test(t[3]) ? 12 : 0);
  return `${date}T${pad(h)}:${t[2]}`;
}

/** "26 Y", "33 Year(s)", "5 Month(s)", "12 D" → printed text + age in years (2 decimals). */
export function parseAge(raw: string | undefined): { ageText?: string; ageYears?: number } {
  const s = raw?.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!s) return {};
  let years = 0, found = false;
  for (const m of s.matchAll(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(Y(?:ea)?r?s?|Y|M(?:on)?(?:th)?s?|M|D(?:ay)?s?|D|W(?:ee)?k?s?|W)\b(?:\(s\))?/gi)) {
    const n = Number(m[1]), u = m[2]![0]!.toUpperCase();
    years += u === "Y" ? n : u === "M" ? n / 12 : u === "W" ? n / 52 : n / 365;
    found = true;
  }
  return { ageText: s, ageYears: found ? Math.round(years * 100) / 100 : undefined };
}

export function parseSex(raw: string | undefined): "male" | "female" | "other" | undefined {
  const s = raw?.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!s) return undefined;
  if (/^f/.test(s)) return "female";
  if (/^m/.test(s)) return "male";
  return "other";
}

const TITLES = /^(mrs|mr|ms|miss|master|mast|baby|b\/o|smt|shri|sri|kumari|km|ku|dr)\.?\s+/i;

/** "MRS. DEMO NAME" → { title: "Mrs", name: "DEMO NAME" } */
export function splitTitle(raw: string | undefined): { title?: string; name?: string } {
  const s = raw?.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
  if (!s) return {};
  const m = s.match(TITLES);
  if (!m) return { name: s };
  const t = m[1]!.toLowerCase();
  return { title: t === "b/o" ? "B/O" : t[0]!.toUpperCase() + t.slice(1), name: s.slice(m[0].length).trim() || undefined };
}

/** Medical council registration in a signatory line: "ABMC1234/2020", "XYMC:12345", "DMC Regno:12345". */
export const REGISTRATION = /\(?\b((?:[A-Z]{2,5}MC|[A-Z]MC|RMCR?|MCI|NMC|DMC|KMC|MMC)\b\s*(?:Reg(?:n|d|istration)?\.?\s*(?:No\.?)?)?\s*[:\-.]?\s*-?\s*\d[\d/-]*|(?:[A-Z]{2,5}MC)\d[\d/-]*)\)?/i;

export function roleOf(...texts: (string | undefined)[]): SignatoryRole {
  const t = texts.filter(Boolean).join(" ").toLowerCase();
  if (/patholog|path\b/.test(t)) return "pathologist";
  if (/biochem/.test(t)) return "biochemist";
  if (/microbio/.test(t)) return "microbiologist";
  if (/manager|operations|technical|technologist|incharge|in-charge/.test(t)) return "manager";
  if (/consultant/.test(t)) return "consultant";
  return "unknown";
}

export const isMedical = (name: string | null | undefined, qualification?: string) =>
  /^dr\.?\s/i.test(name ?? "") || /\b(M\.?\s?D|D\.?N\.?B|M\.?B\.?B\.?S|Ph\.?\s?D|DCP|MD\s*PATH)\b/i.test(qualification ?? "");

/**
 * Two printed lines of a signatory ("Dr Demo Name, MD" / "Consultant Pathologist (ABMC1234/2020)")
 * → name, qualification, registration, title.
 */
export function parseSignatoryText(nameLine: string | undefined, titleLine: string | undefined) {
  let name: string | null = nameLine?.trim() || null;
  let qualification: string | undefined;
  let title = titleLine?.trim() || undefined;
  let registration: string | undefined;
  for (const part of [title, name]) {
    const m = part?.match(REGISTRATION);
    if (m) {
      registration = m[1]!.replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
      if (part === title) title = title!.replace(m[0], "").replace(/[\s,()]+$/, "").trim() || undefined;
      else name = name!.replace(m[0], "").replace(/[\s,]+$/, "").trim() || null;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (name) {
    const m = name.match(/^(.*?)[,\s]+((?:M\.?\s?D|D\.?N\.?B|M\.?B\.?B\.?S|Ph\.?\s?D|M\.?Sc|B\.?Sc|DCP)\b.*)$/i);
    if (m && m[1]) [name, qualification] = [m[1].trim(), m[2]!.trim()];
  }
  // a title line that is really a qualification ("M.D.,DNB,PATHOLOGY", "MD, Pathology")
  if (title && /^(M\.?\s?D|D\.?N\.?B|M\.?B\.?B\.?S|Ph\.?\s?D)\b/i.test(title)) {
    qualification = qualification ? `${qualification}, ${title}` : title;
    title = undefined;
  }
  if (qualification) qualification = qualification.replace(/\s*,\s*/g, ", ").replace(/,\s*$/, "");
  return { name, qualification, registration, title };
}

export interface HeaderField {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  y: number;
}

/**
 * Key/value pairs from a report header laid out in columns ("PT Name : X   Age : Y   SAMPLE : Z").
 * `splits` are the x positions where a new column starts. A label whose value is not on its own line
 * takes an orphan ": value" printed a few points away in the same column, else the next plain line below.
 */
export function headerFields(lines: Line[], splits: number[], labels: RegExp[]): HeaderField[] {
  type Cell = { col: number; y: number; text: string };
  const cellsOut: Cell[] = [];
  for (const l of lines) {
    const byCol = new Map<number, string[]>();
    for (const it of l.items) {
      const col = splits.filter((s) => it.x >= s - 2).length;
      byCol.set(col, [...(byCol.get(col) ?? []), it.s]);
    }
    for (const [col, parts] of byCol) cellsOut.push({ col, y: l.y, text: parts.join(" ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim() });
  }
  const fields: (HeaderField & { col: number })[] = [];
  const orphans: Cell[] = [], plain: Cell[] = [];
  for (const c of cellsOut) {
    const re = labels.find((r) => r.test(c.text));
    if (re) {
      const m = c.text.match(re)!;
      fields.push({ col: c.col, label: m[0].replace(/[\s:]+$/, "").replace(/\s+/g, " "), value: c.text.slice(m[0].length).replace(/^\s*:?\s*/, "").trim(), y: c.y });
    } else if (/^:/.test(c.text)) orphans.push(c);
    else plain.push(c);
  }
  for (const f of fields) {
    if (f.value) continue;
    const near = orphans.filter((o) => o.col === f.col && Math.abs(o.y - f.y) <= 6).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a.y - f.y) - Math.abs(b.y - f.y))[0];
    if (near) {
      f.value = near.text.replace(/^:\s*/, "");
      orphans.splice(orphans.indexOf(near), 1);
      continue;
    }
    const below = plain.filter((p) => p.col === f.col && p.y > f.y && p.y - f.y <= 13).sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y)[0];
    if (below) {
      f.value = below.text;
      plain.splice(plain.indexOf(below), 1);
    }
  }
  return fields.map(({ label, value, y }) => ({ label, value, y }));
}

/** First value of the field whose label matches. */
export const field = (fields: HeaderField[], re: RegExp) => fields.find((f) => re.test(f.label))?.value || undefined;

export const uniq = <T>(xs: (T | undefined | null | "")[]) => [...new Set(xs.filter((x): x is T => !!x))];

export function emptyReport(): Pick<ExtractedReport, "patient" | "sample" | "dates" | "tests" | "signatories" | "accreditation" | "warnings"> {
  return { patient: {}, sample: { barcodes: [], sampleIds: [], ordered: [] }, dates: {}, tests: [], signatories: [], accreditation: [], warnings: [] };
}
```

## File: src/types.ts

```ts
/** Output of report-reader: one external lab report, normalised across labs. */

export interface Box {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
}

export type LabId = "hypatho" | "clinova";

export type Flag = "H" | "L" | "";

export interface Parameter {
  name: string;
  /** exactly as printed */
  value: string;
  unit?: string;
  /** reference range as printed, newlines between multi-line ranges */
  range?: string;
  method?: string;
  /** printed flag, else computed from a numeric value and a simple range ("a - b", "< x", "> x") */
  flag: Flag;
}

export interface TestSection {
  /** panel or test name, e.g. "Complete Blood Count (CBC)" */
  name: string;
  department?: string;
  sampleType?: string;
  /** sample / barcode id printed on this section's page (Clinova prints one per sample tube) */
  sampleId?: string;
  /** approval date printed on this section's page, ISO local time (IST) "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm" */
  reported?: string;
  /** method printed under the panel name (each parameter also carries its own) */
  method?: string;
  /** symbol printed before the name, e.g. Hy Patho's "*"; its meaning is the lab's */
  mark?: string;
  /** sub-headings seen inside the table, kept in order */
  parameters: (Parameter & { group?: string })[];
  /** narrative under the table (reference notes, interpretation, clinical significance) */
  notes?: string;
  /** pages this section appears on (1-based) */
  pages: number[];
  /** ids of the signatories on those pages */
  signedBy: string[];
  /**
   * Does the page carrying this test show the performing lab's accreditation mark?
   * true: every page of the section carries the NABL mark (logo or legend).
   * false: the report uses NABL marks, but not on this section's pages: do not label it accredited.
   * undefined: the report carries no accreditation marks at all.
   */
  accredited?: boolean;
}

export type SignatoryRole = "pathologist" | "biochemist" | "microbiologist" | "consultant" | "manager" | "unknown";

export interface Signatory {
  /** stable id: the signature's fingerprint */
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  qualification?: string;
  registration?: string;
  title?: string;
  role: SignatoryRole;
  /** true when a medical consultant (reports are clinically signed by these) */
  medical: boolean;
  signature: {
    /** sha256 of the decoded pixels (16 hex) */
    sha: string;
    /** 64-bit perceptual hash, to recognise re-encoded copies */
    dhash: string;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    /** set by the CLI when it writes the PNG */
    file?: string;
  };
  /** how the name was obtained */
  source: "text" | "registry" | "unknown";
  pages: number[];
}

/**
 * Accreditation of the PERFORMING lab, as evidenced on this report. It describes the lab that ran the
 * tests, never the collection centre; and a certificate covers only the tests in its scope.
 */
export interface Accreditation {
  body: "NABL" | "CAP" | "ISO";
  /** e.g. "MC-3860" */
  certificate?: string;
  /** how we know: the accreditation mark (image) and/or printed text */
  evidence: ("logo" | "text")[];
  /** pages carrying the evidence */
  pages: number[];
}

export interface ExtractedReport {
  source: {
    file?: string;
    /** sha256 of the PDF: a signature may only be shown with results from this exact document */
    sha256: string;
    lab: LabId;
    labName: string;
    processedAt?: string;
    pages: number;
  };
  patient: {
    name?: string;
    title?: string;
    ageText?: string;
    ageYears?: number;
    sex?: "male" | "female" | "other";
    patientId?: string;
  };
  sample: {
    bookingId?: string;
    barcodes: string[];
    sampleIds: string[];
    labCode?: string;
    collectedAt?: string;
    referredBy?: string;
    customer?: string;
    /** what was ordered, as printed (Hy Patho "INV") */
    ordered: string[];
  };
  dates: {
    registered?: string;
    collected?: string;
    received?: string;
    reported?: string;
  };
  tests: TestSection[];
  signatories: Signatory[];
  accreditation: Accreditation[];
  warnings: string[];
}

/**
 * A signature the caller already knows. Hy Patho prints the signer's name only inside the signature
 * image, so naming needs this registry; keep it in your database, not in source control.
 */
export interface KnownSignature {
  /** pixel sha (16 hex) values of this signature */
  sha?: string[];
  /** perceptual hashes; matched within a few bits, so re-encoded copies are recognised */
  dhash?: string[];
  name: string;
  qualification?: string;
  registration?: string;
  title?: string;
  role?: SignatoryRole;
  lab?: LabId;
}

export interface ExtractOptions {
  /** file name, kept in source.file */
  file?: string;
  /** signatures you have named before (see KnownSignature) */
  signatures?: KnownSignature[];
  /** keep signature pixels (RGBA) in the result's `images` map; default true */
  signatureImages?: boolean;
}

/** Signature pixels by signatory id, for rendering or storing as PNG (see toPng). */
export type SignatureImages = Map<string, { width: number; height: number; rgba: Uint8ClampedArray }>;
```

## File: test/extract.test.ts

```ts
// Tests run on synthetic reports from scripts/make-fixtures.ts (fictional data only).
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { test } from "node:test";
import { extractReport, labelFor, UnsupportedReportError, type KnownSignature } from "../src/index";
import { computeFlag } from "../src/table";
import { isoDate, parseAge, parseSignatoryText, splitTitle } from "../src/text";

const fixture = (name: string) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(new URL(`./fixtures/${name}`, import.meta.url)));

test("Hy Patho layout: header, panels across pages, wrapped names, groups, notes, mark", async () => {
  const { report: r, images } = await extractReport(fixture("hypatho-demo.pdf"), { file: "hypatho-demo.pdf" });
  assert.equal(r.source.lab, "hypatho");
  assert.equal(r.source.processedAt, "HY PATHO LAB, RAIPUR");
  assert.deepEqual(r.patient, { name: "TEST PATIENT", title: "Mr", ageText: "40 Y", ageYears: 40, sex: "male" });
  assert.equal(r.sample.bookingId, "100001 DEMO - 1");
  assert.deepEqual(r.sample.barcodes, ["BC0001"]);
  assert.deepEqual(r.sample.ordered, ["DEMO PANEL"]);
  assert.equal(r.sample.collectedAt, "DEMO COLLECTION CENTRE");
  assert.deepEqual(r.dates, { registered: "2026-01-01T09:00", received: "2026-01-01T10:00", reported: "2026-01-01T17:30" });

  assert.equal(r.tests.length, 2);
  const [cbc, thyroid] = r.tests;
  assert.equal(cbc!.name, "COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT");
  assert.deepEqual(cbc!.pages, [1, 2]);
  assert.equal(cbc!.sampleType, "SERUM");
  const by = (n: string) => cbc!.parameters.find((p) => p.name.startsWith(n))!;
  assert.deepEqual(by("Hemoglobin"), { name: "Hemoglobin", value: "9.50", unit: "g/dL", range: "13 - 17", method: "SLS-Hemoglobin", flag: "L" });
  assert.equal(by("Mean Corpuscular").name, "Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration (MCHC)");
  assert.equal(by("Mean Corpuscular").flag, "H");
  assert.equal(by("Neutrophils").group, "DIFFERENTIAL COUNT");
  assert.equal(by("Platelet").method, "Electrical Impedance", "method printed at the top of the next page");
  assert.equal(by("Erythrocyte").unit, "mm at end of Ist hr");

  assert.equal(thyroid!.name, "THYROID PROFILE");
  assert.equal(thyroid!.mark, "*");
  assert.match(thyroid!.notes ?? "", /^Interpretation:/);

  // the name is only inside the signature image: unnamed until registered
  assert.equal(r.signatories.length, 1);
  const sig = r.signatories[0]!;
  assert.equal(sig.name, null);
  assert.deepEqual(sig.pages, [2, 3]);
  assert.deepEqual(cbc!.signedBy, [sig.id]);
  assert.ok(images.get(sig.id)?.rgba.length);
  assert.match(r.warnings.join("\n"), /unnamed signature/);
  assert.equal(cbc!.accredited, undefined, "no accreditation marks in this report");
});

test("signature registry names Hy Patho signers (exact and perceptual match)", async () => {
  const { report: first } = await extractReport(fixture("hypatho-demo.pdf"));
  const s = first.signatories[0]!.signature;
  const known: KnownSignature = { name: "Dr Demo Signer", qualification: "MD Path", registration: "XYMC 0001", role: "pathologist" };
  for (const registry of [[{ ...known, sha: [s.sha] }], [{ ...known, dhash: [s.dhash.replace(/.$/, (c) => ((parseInt(c, 16) ^ 1).toString(16)))] }]]) {
    const { report: r } = await extractReport(fixture("hypatho-demo.pdf"), { signatures: registry });
    const sig = r.signatories[0]!;
    assert.equal(sig.name, "Dr Demo Signer");
    assert.equal(sig.source, "registry");
    assert.equal(sig.role, "pathologist");
    assert.equal(sig.medical, true);
    assert.equal(r.warnings.length, 0);
  }
});

test("Clinova layout: per-page samples, panels, multi-line ranges, signatories, NABL per test", async () => {
  const { report: r } = await extractReport(fixture("clinova-demo.pdf"));
  assert.equal(r.source.lab, "clinova");
  assert.equal(r.source.processedAt, "Clinova Pathlabs, Demo Central Lab, Demo City - 000000");
  assert.deepEqual(r.patient, { name: "DEMO PERSON", title: "Mr", ageText: "35 Year(s)", ageYears: 35, sex: "male", patientId: "900001" });
  assert.equal(r.sample.labCode, "CPL-XX-001");
  assert.deepEqual(r.sample.sampleIds, ["S-001", "S-002"]);
  assert.deepEqual(r.dates, { collected: "2026-01-02T08:15", registered: "2026-01-02T10:00", reported: "2026-01-02T12:30" });

  const [lipid, esr] = r.tests;
  assert.equal(lipid!.name, "LIPID PROFILE");
  assert.equal(lipid!.department, "CLINICAL BIOCHEMISTRY");
  assert.equal(lipid!.sampleId, "S-001");
  assert.equal(lipid!.parameters[0]!.range, "<200 - Desirable\n200-239 - Borderline risk\n>240 - High risk");
  assert.equal(lipid!.parameters[0]!.method, "CHOD-PAP");
  assert.equal(lipid!.parameters[1]!.flag, "L");
  assert.match(lipid!.notes ?? "", /cardiovascular risk/);
  assert.equal(esr!.name, "Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR)");
  assert.equal(esr!.department, "HEMATOLOGY");
  assert.equal(esr!.parameters[0]!.flag, "H", "<= 20 with 30");

  const doctor = r.signatories.find((s) => s.medical)!;
  assert.deepEqual(
    { name: doctor.name, q: doctor.qualification, reg: doctor.registration, title: doctor.title, role: doctor.role, source: doctor.source },
    { name: "Dr Demo Pathologist", q: "MD", reg: "XYMC1234/2020", title: "Consultant Pathologist", role: "pathologist", source: "text" },
  );
  const manager = r.signatories.find((s) => !s.medical)!;
  assert.equal(manager.role, "manager");
  assert.ok(doctor.signature.sha && manager.signature.sha && doctor.signature.sha !== manager.signature.sha);

  // the NABL legend is on page 1 only: lipid is marked, ESR is not
  assert.deepEqual(r.accreditation, [{ body: "NABL", certificate: "MC-9999", evidence: ["text"], pages: [1] }]);
  assert.equal(lipid!.accredited, true);
  assert.equal(esr!.accredited, false);

  const l1 = labelFor(r, lipid!), l2 = labelFor(r, esr!);
  assert.equal(l1.text, "Performed at Clinova Pathlabs (NABL accredited, MC-9999) · Reported by Dr Demo Pathologist, MD (XYMC1234/2020)");
  assert.equal(l1.accreditation?.certificate, "MC-9999");
  assert.equal(l2.accreditation, undefined);
  assert.equal(l2.text, "Performed at Clinova Pathlabs · Reported by Dr Demo Pathologist, MD (XYMC1234/2020)");
  assert.deepEqual(l1.reportedBy.map((x) => x.name), ["Dr Demo Pathologist"], "managers are not 'reported by'");
  assert.equal(l1.sourceSha256, r.source.sha256);
});

test("other PDFs are rejected", async () => {
  const { PDFDocument, StandardFonts } = await import("pdf-lib");
  const doc = await PDFDocument.create();
  doc.addPage().drawText("Some other lab", { x: 50, y: 700, font: await doc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica) });
  await assert.rejects(extractReport(await doc.save()), UnsupportedReportError);
});

test("text helpers", () => {
  assert.equal(isoDate("16-06-2026 06:25 PM"), "2026-06-16T18:25");
  assert.equal(isoDate("16-06-2026 12:05 AM"), "2026-06-16T00:05");
  assert.equal(isoDate("2026-03-10 18:46"), "2026-03-10T18:46");
  assert.equal(isoDate("2026-03-10"), "2026-03-10");
  assert.deepEqual(parseAge("5 Month(s)"), { ageText: "5 Month(s)", ageYears: 0.42 });
  assert.deepEqual(parseAge("1 Y 6 M"), { ageText: "1 Y 6 M", ageYears: 1.5 });
  assert.deepEqual(splitTitle("MRS. DEMO NAME"), { title: "Mrs", name: "DEMO NAME" });
  assert.deepEqual(splitTitle("B/O DEMO"), { title: "B/O", name: "DEMO" });
  assert.deepEqual(parseSignatoryText("Dr Demo One", "M.D.,DNB,PATHOLOGY ABMC:12345"), { name: "Dr Demo One", qualification: "M.D., DNB, PATHOLOGY", registration: "ABMC:12345", title: undefined });
  assert.deepEqual(parseSignatoryText("Dr. Demo Two MD", "Consultant Biochemist"), { name: "Dr. Demo Two", qualification: "MD", registration: undefined, title: "Consultant Biochemist" });
  assert.deepEqual(parseSignatoryText(undefined, "Consultant Microbiologist (DMC Regno:12345)"), { name: null, qualification: undefined, registration: "DMC Regno:12345", title: "Consultant Microbiologist" });
  assert.equal(computeFlag("5.2", "2.4 - 5.7"), "");
  assert.equal(computeFlag("19.6", "< 15.00"), "H");
  assert.equal(computeFlag("12", "Up to 10"), "H");
  assert.equal(computeFlag("8", "> 10"), "L");
  assert.equal(computeFlag("Negative", "Negative"), "");
});
```
